title: WI-022 remediation target: the exact wire shape Studio's services writer must emit

provenance.note: Every expected attribute name, omission rule, and unit below is derived from the anchored native capture (see native-recovery-units for the full derivation). Anything not proven by that capture is listed under open_questions rather than asserted here.

derivations: Attribute names are resetFailCountDelay (seconds) and restartServiceDelay (observed at 1000x authored milliseconds); the pre-remediation Studio names resetPeriod and restartDelay appear nowhere in the native corpus and must never be emitted.
A third_failure of 'none' follows the capture's Spooler precedent: thirdFailure is omitted, not emitted as a default.
A null recovery follows the capture's W32Time precedent: the entire recovery attribute set is omitted.

restartServiceDelay for StudioSvcA is 120000 x 1000 = 120000000 per the observed multiplier; the dedicated-capture confirmation (open question in native-recovery-units) must land before this value is cited in certified evidence.

open_questions: Does the WI-022 fix keep Studio's day/minute operator model and convert at the serialization boundary, or re-model to native seconds/microseconds? The corpus is agnostic; the wire expectations above are not.
